description: **`build.sh` small guards after W24**: (a) `proxy/tools/build.sh` honours `WSP_SOURCES` on any run, so an exported value on a native build skips `build_id.py --sources` (the tracked-source refusal and the list); accept it only inside the `--docker` container (a marker `docker run` sets); (b) a host test of the `WSP_TOOLCHAIN=any` branch of `toolchain_check` (a stub `toolchain.py` that exits 2: the id gains `-dirty` once and the build goes on; without the variable, exit 2); (c) `build_id.py --sources` reads the core sources folder from `layout.proxy_src()` while the adapter honours `--root`: take both from `--root` Why: none bites today (CI and `--docker` never set the variable by hand; W24 report deviation 12 names (b) untested); in the next job that changes `build.sh` anyway (a build-id input, so not alone) Raised: W24 review round 1 Later 1 to 3, 2026-11-04
title: `build.sh` small guards after W24
